description: x402 Listing Check: Pre-listing check: is an endpoint payable by a default x402 client? Fetch the URL, read its 402 challenge, verify accepts[] is complete (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), check the input example for placeholders, and measure it against the 8,190 B edge line limit. Answer is READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Use before listing, or when a buyer says your endpoint does not work.
name: x402-listing-check
